# Anastasis Giakoumatos

> Senior Mobile Engineer specializing in Android, based in Athens, Greece. 7 years building banking, payments and iGaming apps used by millions of people, and using agentic development (Claude Code, coding agents) and CI/CD automation to ship mobile apps faster without lowering quality.

Anastasis works daily with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose on modern Android architectures (MVI, MVVM, Clean Architecture, multi-module). He has led large-scale modularization efforts, mentored developers, and raised code quality through testing and code reviews in large cross-functional teams. He also builds AI-powered features into his own apps and is available for freelance mobile app development through AGcoding.

## Experience

- Cognity (B2B contract), Senior Android Developer, Nov 2025 - present: led the modularization of Eurobank's mobile banking app (10+ feature modules) and helped raise unit test coverage by 6%. Owns features for insurance and account products (Happy Pet pet insurance, under-18 accounts, Travellers card) and coordinated a production release. Team of 35-40 Android developers.
- BetssonGroup, Senior Android Developer, Jan 2024 - Nov 2025: built native Jetpack Compose/MVI screens replacing WebView in the Sportsbook, owning parts of the Bet Slip and live/settled bet counters. Created 8+ feature modules in a team effort that raised crash-free sessions from 94.0% to 98%. Used AI to generate per-brand design tokens from Figma. Hit the quarterly QA rejection target (below 3%).
- Viva.com, Android Engineer, Oct 2022 - Jan 2024: owned tablet and landscape support across 35+ screens of the Viva.com Terminal POS app (1M+ users, 10+ countries), built Kiosk mode, and led the rebranding from VivaWallet to Viva.com as main developer.
- M-Stat, Android Engineer, Oct 2019 - Oct 2022: built and maintained 15+ Android apps for insurance and loyalty clients, including Piraeus Bank's Yellow and the KRAFT Pro App (Impact BITE Awards 2021), later supporting them as the sole Android developer. Tech lead for one year.

## Projects

- [Cariboo](https://anastasis-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/cariboo/): personal car-management app on Google Play, built and shipped solo with agentic development (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Claude Design): 50+ screens, 400+ commits over 10 months. Offline-first with Room, Hilt and WorkManager, Supabase backend, GitHub Actions CI/CD, GPT-powered voice entry.
- [Honestli](https://anastasis-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/honestli/): freelance Android app that fights misinformation; built the CameraX-based camera, secure sharing with newsrooms, SSL pinning and Android Keystore encryption.
